note: SEEDED EXAMPLES, not real incident history: resolved incidents written for Ironclad so LogScribe's RAG over past errors has something to match before the first real failure. Load with: logscribe seed --config logscribe/ironclad.toml

incidents.message: Database error: ConnectionRefusedError: [Errno 61] Connect call failed ('127.0.0.1', 5432)
incidents.symptom: Every bank-service endpoint that touches the database returns 500; the web app shows no balances and transfers fail. The agent's tools report upstream_error.
incidents.cause: Postgres was down (container restarted / brew service stopped), so the asyncpg pool couldn't open or reuse connections.
incidents.fix: Start Postgres (docker compose up -d db, or brew services start postgresql). The pool reconnects on the next request; no bank-service restart needed unless it failed at startup.

incidents.message: Database error: ConnectionDoesNotExistError: connection was closed in the middle of operation
incidents.symptom: A burst of 500s from bank-service right after a database restart, then recovery.
incidents.cause: Postgres restarted while the pool held open connections; the first queries on those stale connections failed.
incidents.fix: Usually self-heals once Postgres is back. If it persists, restart bank-service to rebuild the pool.

incidents.message: Database error: UndefinedObjectError: type "vector" does not exist
incidents.symptom: Policy search (GET /policies/search) and migrations fail; the banking agent can't cite policies.
incidents.cause: The pgvector extension isn't installed in the database (a plain postgres image instead of pgvector/pgvector, or CREATE EXTENSION never ran).
incidents.fix: Use the pgvector/pgvector image or install pgvector, run CREATE EXTENSION vector as a superuser, then python -m app.cli migrate and index-policies.

incidents.message: LLM provider error (openai, status 429): RateLimitError: Error code: 429 - Rate limit reached for requests
incidents.symptom: Chat replies fail with an error during busy periods; policy search may also return POLICY_SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE.
incidents.cause: The OpenAI project hit its requests- or tokens-per-minute limit (agent model, injection classifier and embeddings share one key).
incidents.fix: Back off and retry; raise the project's rate limit tier or spread load. Check for a runaway loop sending repeated requests.

incidents.message: LLM provider error (openai, status 401): AuthenticationError: Error code: 401 - Incorrect API key provided
incidents.symptom: Every chat message fails immediately with an error reply; nothing reaches the bank.
incidents.cause: OPENAI_API_KEY was rotated, revoked or mistyped in the agent-service environment.
incidents.fix: Set a valid OPENAI_API_KEY for agent-service and restart it.

incidents.message: OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS: Too many incorrect OTP attempts. Transfer cancelled.
incidents.symptom: Many transfers cancelled after 3 wrong OTPs in a short window.
incidents.cause: Either users entering codes from an old or different transfer (UX issue), or someone guessing OTPs on transfers they started.
incidents.fix: Check whether failures cluster on one user or source; if it's guessing, lock the account and review. If it's UX, make sure the OTP modal shows the code for the transfer being confirmed.

incidents.symptom: A merchant's payment requests (POST /payments/requests) all fail with 401; their checkout and agent can't take payment.
incidents.cause: The merchant key was rotated (python -m app.cli merchants issue-key) and the merchant is still sending the old one.
incidents.fix: Give the merchant the new key (shown once at issue time) and update their IRONCLAD_MERCHANT_KEY. Reissuing again won't help while the old key is still configured.
